title: A Long Patio.
A Large Covered Garage.
front.introHead: Start at the back of the house
front.intro: Behind this East End bungalow, a covered patio runs beside a large covered garage in the fully fenced yard. The Breakfast Nook opens to the rear deck, the driveway is new, and the fence is new too. Inside, the wiring, plumbing and roof are all new, along with the kitchen and both baths. The foundation was reworked, leveled and braced before any of it went in. Navigation Esplanade and the East End taquerias are a short drive away.

caps.name: Front of the home
caps.text: Hardi Plank siding and a new roof, with a new walk to the covered stoop. The front door opens straight into the 16'3" x 12'6" Living Room from the stoop. Board and batten covers the front gable.

caps.name: Breakfast Nook
caps.text: Windows on two walls, with the Kitchen along one side. The rear door leads out to the deck, the fenced yard and the covered patio. The Dining area and the Kitchen peninsula are a few steps away.

caps.name: Kitchen
caps.text: All new, in an L with a peninsula that opens to the Dining area and Living Room. Navy lower cabinets, white uppers and marble-look counters. The pantry and the Breakfast Nook are around the corner.

front.outro: The house is freestanding, in a modern Mediterranean style. Some of Houston's best restaurants are a few minutes away. At sunset, the downtown skyline lights up from the roof patio. Stucco and cement board cover the outside. Clay tile caps the roofline over the second-floor balcony. Soft-closing cabinets and drawers fill the kitchen. The laundry room is inside the house. A dry bar with a built-in wine cooler sits beside the kitchen.

back.title: The Rooms Behind the Covered Spaces

The Dining area sits between the Kitchen and the hall to the bedrooms. Approximate and not to scale; the buyer verifies every room size before relying on it.

photo.text: The right end of the plan, seen from the fenced yard, with the deck beside it. Room to park a car or to set up for a crowd.

band.small: An East End bungalow with the big work done. The roof and siding are new. The yard is fully fenced. The driveway is new.
band.head: What is new

floors.label: Front rooms
floors.text: The front door opens into the Living Room. A wide cased opening joins it to the Dining area and the Kitchen. The Breakfast Nook sits beside the Kitchen, with a door to the rear deck. Wood-look floors run through with no thresholds. The Kitchen has a peninsula with two pendant lights.

floors.label: Bedrooms and baths
floors.text: The Primary Bedroom is at the back of the house, with a vaulted ceiling. The Primary Bath has double sinks and a walk-in shower. Two secondary bedrooms share the hall bath. Each bedroom has a closet.

floors.label: Covered spaces
floors.text: A covered patio and a large covered garage sit side by side in the fenced yard. The garage is wide and deep enough to park under, to work in or to set up for a crowd. The patio is open on the yard side. The driveway and the fence are both new. String lights are already up over the patio.

floors.label: Rooftop
floors.text: A rooftop patio is up the last flight. It has wide-angle views of downtown Houston. Outdoor seating fits beside the door. A low wall rings the whole patio. A door at the top of the stair opens to the roof.

back.footnote: Information deemed reliable but not guaranteed. Room dimensions are approximate, from the listing's floor plan. Living area of 1,385 square feet per HCAD.

top.title: From the Nook to the Yard

items.name: Breakfast Nook
items.text: Windows fill two walls of the nook, beside the Kitchen. Its rear door leads out to the deck and down into the backyard. The Kitchen peninsula and the Dining area are a few steps away.

items.name: Backyard
items.text: Past the deck steps, the covered patio (8'11" x 25'11") and the large covered garage (14'4" x 24'3") sit at the back of the fenced yard. String lights are already up over the patio and the deck.

items.name: Dining Area
items.text: From the Dining area, the front door and Living Room are on one side and the Kitchen peninsula is on the other. Wood-look floors run through with no thresholds. The hall to the bedrooms starts here.

items.name: Living Room
items.text: The front door opens into the Living Room. A wide cased opening joins it to the Dining area and Kitchen. A clerestory window high on the wall adds daylight and keeps privacy.

items.name: Breakfast Bar
items.text: Two pendant lights hang over the peninsula, with room for barstools. The Dining area sits between the peninsula and the hall to the bedrooms. Marble-look counters run its full length.

items.name: Kitchen
items.text: Everything here is new, with a stainless range under a chimney hood. The sink and dishwasher sit a step apart along the L. The pantry and the Breakfast Nook are around the corner.

bottom.kicker: The back half of the house
bottom.title: Bedrooms, Baths and Built-Ins

groups.head: The primary, at the back of the home

items.name: Primary Bedroom
items.text: Set at the back of the home, away from the street. The vaulted ceiling carries an exposed painted beam. It fits a king bed and a long dresser.

items.name: Closet Wall
items.text: The Primary has a double-door closet. A doorway on the closet wall leads to the Primary Bath. The hall to the other bedrooms is a few steps away.

items.name: Bedroom 2
items.text: The larger secondary bedroom sits at the front corner, across the home from the Primary. Windows on two walls. New carpet underfoot.

items.name: Bedroom 3
items.text: The closet sits on the hall side, leaving the window wall open for a desk. The hall bath is a few steps away. New carpet underfoot.

items.name: Double Vanity
items.text: Double sinks on a dark navy vanity with drawers. A wide LED mirror lights the wall above the sinks. Two people can get ready at the same time.

items.name: Glass Shower
items.text: Marble-look tile runs floor to ceiling over a pebble tile floor. A long niche holds shampoo and soap. A rain showerhead and a handheld.

items.name: Primary Closet
items.text: Double doors open to a shelving tower with hanging rods on both sides. Shelves above hold bins or luggage. The built-ins stay with the house.

items.name: Hall Bath
items.text: Bedrooms 2 and 3 share this bath. A tub with full-height marble-look tile and a pebble tile niche. A window over the tub. Everything in it is new.
